questions: What drew you to product design, and what excites you about this opportunity?
Tell me about a time you were new to something. How did you go about learning it?
Can you describe a situation where you received feedback and how you acted on it?
How do you approach understanding user needs before designing?
Tell me about a time you had to collaborate with someone who thought differently than you.
When you're unsure how to start solving a design problem, what steps do you take?
Walk us through a project in your portfolio that you're proud of.
What were the constraints or goals, and how did you respond to them?
What part of the project was most challenging, and how did you handle it?
Tell me about a time you had to balance user needs with business goals in a project.
How do you approach a design task when the requirements are unclear or incomplete?
Have you ever worked with a PM who changed direction mid-project? How did you handle it?
Describe a moment when you asked questions to improve a product idea.
Tell me how you usually start a design project—what steps do you take first?
Describe a time you received tough feedback on a design. What did you do with it?
Walk me through how you think about hierarchy, layout, or visual clarity in your designs.
What’s one design skill you’re working to improve and how are you approaching it?
Have you ever worked with developers or engineers before? What was that like?
How do you make sure your designs are feasible or easy to build?
Can you explain a design you made where constraints (like time or tech) influenced your decisions?
What’s your process for handing off work or preparing it for implementation?
What do you value most in a team or work environment?
How do you stay motivated when a project feels unclear or slow-moving?
Where do you hope to grow in the next year as a designer and teammate?
